info.title: VEDO Core REST API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of ontologies the authenticated user has access to.
Returns full ontology details including counts of classes, properties, and individuals.
Returns a paginated list of classes in an ontology. Supports text search and parent filter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query against class labels and comments

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Filter by parent class ID (returns direct children)

get.description: Returns full class details including hierarchy breadcrumb, property count, and individual count.
Returns a paginated list of properties. Can be filtered by type (object or datatype).
Returns a paginated list of individuals. Can be filtered by class.

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: Filter by class ID (returns individuals of that class)

post.description:
Execute a read-only SPARQL query against an ontology. Mutation queries (INSERT, DELETE) are rejected.

A mandatory LIMIT of 1000 is enforced if no LIMIT clause is present.

Execute a read-only CYPHER query against an ontology. Mutation queries are rejected.

A mandatory LIMIT of 1000 is enforced if no LIMIT clause is present.

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for this API.
Returns a paginated list of groups. Supports text search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query against group labels

post.description: Creates a new group within the organization hierarchy.

get.description: Returns full group details including children and member count.

put.description: Updates an existing group's label, description, or parent.

delete.description: Deletes a group. Fails if the group still contains projects or subgroups.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of direct child groups.
Returns a paginated list of members in a group.

post.description: Adds a user as a member of a group with the specified role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of projects the authenticated user has access to.

post.description: Creates a new project within a group.

put.description: Updates an existing project's label or description.

delete.description: Deletes a project and all associated ontologies.

put.description: Moves a project to a different group.

target_group_id.description: Target group ID to move the project to

get.description: Returns a paginated list of members with access to an ontology.

post.description: Adds a user as a member of an ontology with the specified role.

put.description: Updates the role of an ontology member. Cannot remove the last Owner.

delete.description: Removes a member from an ontology. Cannot remove the last Owner.

get.description: Returns the current visibility level of an ontology.

put.description: Sets the visibility level of an ontology.

get.description: Returns a list of access policies for an ontology.

post.description: Creates a new access policy for an ontology.

delete.description: Deletes an access policy from an ontology.

path.description: Ancestor group labels from root to this group

scope.description: Scope of the membership: group or ontology

RoleEnum.description: Permission hierarchy: Guest (read-only) < Reporter (read + comment) < Developer (read/write) < Maintainer (manage members) < Owner (full control)

VisibilityLevel.description: private: only explicit members; internal: all org members; public: anyone

actions.description: List of actions this policy applies to (e.g., view, edit, delete, manage)

subjects.description: List of subject IDs this policy applies to (users or groups)

parent_id.description: Optional parent group ID for nested groups

effect.description: Whether this policy allows or denies the specified actions

actions.description: Actions this policy applies to (e.g., view, edit, delete, manage)

subjects.description: Subject IDs this policy applies to (users or groups)
